statement.p: If 1800 square centimeters of material is available to make a box with a square base and an open top, find the largest possible volume of the box.

Let x be the length of the sides of the square base. Then, if h is the height of the box, the volume is given by x^2h. We need to find an expression for the height h in terms of x.
